paper.core_task: Unsupervised categorical pose estimation from images using learned priors

contributions.name: An unsupervised prior learning challenge for pose estimation
contributions.author_claim_text: We introduce the challenge of unsupervised categorical prior learning in the context of pose estimation.
contributions.description: The authors formally define a new challenge: learning categorical pose priors from images in a self-supervised manner, without human annotations.

contributions.name: A hierarchical memory method for learning pose priors
contributions.author_claim_text: We propose a new method called Pose Prior Learner (PPL) for unsupervised pose estimation. PPL outperforms existing methods across several pose estimation benchmarks and offers explainable visualizations of pose priors.
contributions.description: The paper proposes Pose Prior Learner (PPL), which uses a hierarchical memory to store prototypical poses and distill them into a general categorical pose prior, trained via image reconstruction losses.

contributions.name: An iterative inference strategy for occluded pose estimation
contributions.author_claim_text: During inference, we utilize an iterative strategy in which PPL progressively leverages priors to refine estimated poses by regressing them to the nearest prototypical poses stored in memory.
contributions.description: An iterative inference procedure refines estimated poses in occluded scenes by repeatedly using the learned hierarchical memory and prior to reconstruct and re-estimate poses.

novelty_claims.text: The proposed method is novel and interesting.
